title: Sports lab 2 (source of the round-2 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-2 Sports templates were built and verified in: player lower third, match up, standings table, full-time score, starting lineup, player spotlight, replay stinger and slash wipe.
use_when: You want to see a round-2 sports template working before using it, copy a comp's objects, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py.
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Comps have a 'Lab bg' rectangle (dropped on extraction) except the two transitions.
Clip ids are unique per comp (slt_, smu_, sst_, sft_, slu_, ssp_, srs_, ssw_).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/sports_lab2.py writes the comps; apply its PRESETS with preset.apply, then edit.save.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
